05/29/2009: Station Maintenance:                                        [1145] 
 
            - Rain Collection bucket was found to be full of water 
              due to the funnel being clogged.  The obstruction was 
              removed at 11:45am and the 0.57" was in turn logged 
              by the datalogger.   Nearby manual observation was  
              recorded to be 1.00", therefore the precipitation  
              data prior to 05/27/09 may be inaccurate to to the  
              obstruction, but the rain gauge should be operating 
              properly now.

04/22/2002: Data Cleanup (jtb): 
 
            - Additional data cleanup due to replacement of soil temperature 
              sensor (04/18/02).  Examining data showed a steady decrease in 
              reliability of Soil Temp A (2-inch) after 07/01/2001 (approx.). 
 
              All Soil Temp A (2-inch) data between (and including) the  
              following dates were removed from the Sparta database tables: 
 
                 start of removed records: 06/15/2001 (day=166) - 00:05 
                 end of removed records:   04/18/2002 (day=108) - 18:00 
 
     
04/18/2002: Maintenance (jaa, jtb): 
  
            - Replaced Soil Temp A (2-inch depth).  Time of sensor 
              replacedment was 17:48. 
 
              Replacing the soil temperature sensors introduced errors to  
              the following variables at the listed report times - marked  
              the following as missing in the MAWN database tables for  
              Sparta: 
 
              - Five Minute Data: 
 
                   Air Temperature:              04/18/02 (day=108) - 17:50 
 
 
              - Hourly Data: 
 
                   Air Temperature:              04/18/02 (day=108) - 18:00 
                   Soil Temp A:                  04/18/02 (day=108) - 18:00 
                   Soil Temp B:                  04/18/02 (day=108) - 18:00 
 
 
              - Daily Data: 
 
                   Min Air Temperature:          04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
                   Time of Min Air Temperature:  04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00 
 
                   Max Soil Temp A:              04/18/02 (day=108) - 24:00

09/16/2000: Loss of Telephone Communications on Sept 12, 2000 
            due to electrical storm. 
 
            - Replace Modem (#3945) with new modem (#3947) 
 
            - "Ring" wire was disconnected (actually burnt 
              apart due to apparant electrical surge).   
              Replaced blue (ring) wing with extra orange/wire. 
              Left orange (tip) wire alone 
 
            - Service box by the road - switch blue (ring) wire 
              with orange/white wire.  Connected to red (ring) 
              terminal.  Left orange wire connected to green (tip) 
              terminal.  Still no active line.  Apparently heavy 
              electrical damage to service box. 
 
            - Current wiring: 
 
                 Service Box -> green terminal (tip) -> orange wire 
                             -> Datalogger Enclosure -> bottom surge terminal 
                             -> TIP on modem 
 
                 Service Box -> red terminal (ring) -> orange/white  wire 
                             -> Datalogger Enclosure -> upper surge terminal 
                             -> RING on modem 
                  
            - Downloaded data from datalogger.  Loss of data between 
              (but not including) the following times: 
 
                 Day=255, Time=0630  (Sep 11) 
                 Day=255, Time=1955  (Sep 11)
